threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals the owner's SYS-01 password and session token, and the attacker syncs the CUI project folder (Prime A drawings and models)
threat_source: Foreign intelligence service or contracted cyber actor targeting defense suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA uses relayable authenticator codes; no alert on new sign-in locations or bulk downloads; logs never reviewed; passwords kept in a spreadsheet in the same account; no CUI or phishing training
existing_controls: MFA with authenticator app; provider spam filtering
treatment_plan: Move CUI to SYS-10 with hardware security keys; password manager and delete the spreadsheet; monthly sign-in review; CUI handling and phishing training; P08 runbook

threat_event: CUI is stored and transmitted in a commercial cloud suite that does not meet FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent requirements, breaching the subcontract and possibly releasing ITAR technical data through provider storage or support outside the carve-out
threat_source: Owner (service choice made before the contract terms were understood)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 offering not FedRAMP authorized or equivalent; provider holds the keys, so the 22 CFR 120.54(a)(5) carve-out cannot apply; Prime A engineers email CUI to SYS-01
treatment_plan: SYS-10 ordered 2026-08-31; migrate all CUI and delete it from SYS-01 (including deleted items and versions); ask Prime A engineers to use only the portal or SYS-10; counsel review of the ITAR question

threat_event: The SPRS score of 110 posted 2025-05-20 overstates implementation (recalculated in P03), and a CMMC affirmation made on the same basis would be false, exposing the owner personally to contract remedies and False Claims Act liability (31 U.S.C. 3729)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score built from a template in one evening without evidence; no SSP describing the real system; sole proprietor has unlimited personal liability
treatment_plan: Post the corrected score and the date-to-110 in SPRS by 2026-09-15; tell Prime A's subcontract administrator in writing; affirm only after an evidence-based self-assessment; outside review by the CMMC consultant before each SPRS entry

threat_event: The owner cannot show a CMMC Level 2 (Self) status and affirmation in SPRS before the follow-on Prime A award, and loses about 70% of revenue
threat_source: Contract requirement (Prime A flowdown of DFARS 252.204-7021)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recalculated score far below the 88 needed for Conditional status; open items that may not be on a POA&M (3.1.20, 3.1.22, 3.10.3, 3.10.4, 3.10.5, 3.12.4); one person to do the work
treatment_plan: Run the P03 roadmap; outside review in 2027-01; post the self-assessment and affirmation by 2027-01-15; ask Prime A whether the award date can follow a Conditional status

threat_event: Burglary, car theft, or loss takes the laptop or the USB backup drive with CUI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB backup drive not encrypted and kept in an unlocked drawer; laptop disk recovery key stored in SYS-01; laptop carried to Prime A reviews
existing_controls: Laptop disk encrypted; monitored house alarm
treatment_plan: Replace the backup drive with a FIPS-validated encrypted drive kept in the home safe; move the recovery key to the safe; never leave the laptop in a vehicle

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours, and images are not preserved for 90 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DoD-approved medium assurance certificate; no incident plan or contacts; no way to image the laptop; no forensics help arranged
treatment_plan: Obtain the medium assurance certificate and register for DIBNet; adopt the P08 runbook; agree on-call terms with a digital forensics firm and the IT consultant; tabletop walkthrough

threat_event: CUI specification excerpts pasted into a commercial AI chatbot are kept by the provider, used for model training, or seen by its staff
threat_source: Owner error (service provider holds the data)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI tools before 2026-08-31; consumer terms; training on chats was on by default
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09; CUI excerpts from Prime A specifications
existing_controls: Chat history deleted and training turned off 2026-07-17
treatment_plan: Never use the chatbot with CUI; decide with counsel and Prime A whether the pastes are a reportable cyber incident and an ITAR question; approved-tools list (P10)

threat_event: A compromised family device or smart TV on the shared home network attacks the laptop or printer, or intercepts traffic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat home network shared by family devices, guests, and a smart TV; no monitoring; printer accepts jobs from any device
existing_controls: Laptop host firewall; router blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Separate business network for the laptop and printer; family and guests on their own network; printer reachable only from the business network

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting SaaS exposes FCI and lets an attacker redirect Prime A payments or send fake invoices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password only on SYS-05; payment details changed by email without a call-back
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; confirm any bank detail change with Prime A by phone to a known number

threat_event: CUI email attachments cached on the personal phone are exposed when the phone is lost or backed up to a personal cloud account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email app opens CUI attachments; phone backups go to a personal consumer cloud
existing_controls: Passcode and biometric lock; device encryption
treatment_plan: Remove CUI from SYS-01 mail; after migration the phone has only the MFA app and non-CUI email; turn on remote wipe

threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts CAD work and the change syncs to the cloud folder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner works daily as administrator; IT consultant's setup administrator account was enabled until 2026-08-05; CAD software two releases behind; no vulnerability scanning; backup drive always on the desk
existing_controls: Built-in antivirus; automatic OS updates; 30-day version history in SYS-01
treatment_plan: Standard user account for daily work; remove unused accounts; monthly scans and CAD updates; backup drive disconnected and locked away between backups; quarterly restore test

threat_event: Household visitors or the cleaning service see or take printed CUI in the home office
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office door often unlocked; spare key in the kitchen; printed drawings left on the desk; no visitor log
treatment_plan: Lock the office whenever anyone else is in the house; remove the spare key; locked cabinet for prints; cleaning service only with the owner present; visitor log

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so deliverables, DoD reporting, and Prime A communication stop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA on one phone; CUI cannot be handed to anyone else
treatment_plan: Written continuity arrangement with Prime A; sealed recovery codes and emergency sheet in the home safe; spare hardware key (P05)

threat_event: A hurricane closes the home office or cuts power and internet for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; one internet connection
existing_controls: Project files in the cloud; laptop leaves with the owner on evacuation
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Tell Prime A at a storm watch; work only on the laptop at an approved alternate site (POL-01 9.2)

threat_event: An attacker on the home network signs in to the router with its default administrator password and changes DNS to send the owner to phishing pages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Router administrator password was the factory default printed on the label (P07, 2026-08-05); firmware not updated since 2024
existing_controls: Default password changed 2026-08-05 during the P07 test
treatment_plan: Update firmware; turn off remote administration and UPnP; record router settings in the baseline
